user.title: Hypontech inverter
user.description: Enter the address of the RS485-to-Ethernet converter (Waveshare in Modbus TCP <-> RTU mode).

data_description.slave: Inverter address on the RS485 bus (set in the inverter menu, 1-16).
data_description.scan_interval: Default 10 s. If another integration uses the same converter, do not set a shorter interval.

no_response.title: Inverter does not respond
no_response.description: The converter responds, but the inverter does not. An on-grid inverter is off without sunlight (e.g. at night). If the slave address is correct, you can add the integration now - entities will update when the inverter wakes up.

data_description.timeout: Per request (default 5 s). With several connections (e.g. another integration) the Waveshare converter may hold a response for 2-5 s.
data_description.retries: How many times to repeat an unanswered request (default 1). At night the integration sends only one request per minute without retries.
data_description.lock_minutes: After this time the settings lock again (default 10).
data_description.tolerance: After how many consecutive cycles without response the inverter is considered off (night). Until then entities keep their last values. Default 3.

read_registers.name: Read registers
read_registers.description: Reads a range of inverter registers (diagnostics). The result is shown in Developer tools → Actions.
